import java.util.Scanner;

public class Main {
    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        double x = sc.nextDouble();
        double y = sc.nextDouble();
        long n = sc.nextLong();

        double minDifference = 1e9;
        double num = 0;
        long den = 0;

        for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) {
            long lcm = gcdLL((long) y, i);
            long ip = (long) (x * (lcm / y));
            long denomPart = lcm / i;

            if (ip % denomPart == 0) {
                ip /= denomPart;
            } else {
                double val = ip;
                double denom = denomPart;
                val = (val / denom) + 0.49;
                ip = (long) val;
            }

            double ip_value = ip;
            double currentDifference = Math.abs(x / y - ip_value / (double) i);
            if (minDifference > currentDifference) {
                minDifference = currentDifference;
                num = ip_value;
                den = i;
            }
        }

        long g = gcdLL((long) num, den);
        long numerator = (long) num / g;
        long denominator = den / g;

        System.out.println(numerator + "/" + denominator);
    }

    private static long gcdLL(long a, long b) {
        return a * b / gcd(a, b);
    }

    private static long gcd(long a, long b) {
        while (b != 0) {
            long temp = b;
            b = a % b;
            a = temp;
        }
        return a;
    }
}
